# Buttercup Advertising Studio — Full Documentation & LLM Context

## Overview
Buttercup Advertising Studio (BAS) is an independent creative branding, advertising, and design agency headquartered in Ahmedabad, Gujarat, India. The studio specializes in high-impact brand strategy, logo creation, visual identity systems, packaging design, advertising campaigns, and interactive digital web experiences.

Founded and led by Creative Director Sneha Vakta Shah, Buttercup partners with emerging entrepreneurs, D2C startups, mid-market businesses, and large industrial conglomerates to create memorable, commercially resilient brands.

## Service Offerings & Pricing

### 1. Brand Strategy (Starting at ₹49,999)
- Market & Competitor Audit: Analysis of market dynamics, white space opportunities, and category conventions.
- Audience Personas & Journey Mapping: Demographic, psychographic, and behavioral customer segmentation.
- Core Brand Architecture: Mission, vision, core values, brand pillars, and differentiation USP.
- Strategic Brand Positioning & Manifesto: High-conviction brand manifesto and core brand promise.
- URL: https://buttercup.in/pages/services/brand-strategy/

### 2. Visual Identity & Design Systems (Starting at ₹74,999)
- Primary & Secondary Logo Marks: Bespoke wordmarks, symbolic logomarks, and adaptable responsive locks.
- Typography System & Hierarchy: Custom font pairings for digital, print, and editorial applications.
- Color Psychology & Palette: Primary, secondary, and functional color palettes with strict CMYK/RGB/Pantone specifications.
- Brand Guidelines Manual: Comprehensive rulebook for visual consistency across all touchpoints.
- Collateral & Packaging: Business stationery, merchandise, retail packaging, and social templates.
- URL: https://buttercup.in/pages/services/visual-identity/

### 3. Brand Communication & Campaigns (Starting at ₹99,999)
- Campaign Concepts: Big idea conceptualization for product launches and rebrands.
- Creative Copywriting & Tone of Voice: Headline copy, advertising scripts, taglines, and messaging guides.
- Digital & Omnichannel Execution: Social rollout, print advertising, outdoor hoardings, and digital banners.
- URL: https://buttercup.in/pages/services/marketing-communication/

## Industries Served
- **Product-Base Sectors**: FMCG, Food & Beverages, Cosmetics, Lifestyle & Wellness, Textiles, Jewellery, Industrial Lubricants, Pharmaceuticals, Medical Devices, and Electrical Appliances.
- **Service-Base Sectors**: Management Consulting, Information Technology, Industrial Automation, Finance, Real Estate & Infrastructure, Hospitality & Dining, Healthcare, Education, and Renewable Energy.
